g.text: Figure 6 - Feature-family ablation: F3 (feedback adaptivity) carries the detector

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42505e

g.text: Headline number: removing F3 lowers the recall upper bound from 0.933 to 0.733 (-20.0 points, 3 of 15 segments lost); removing F6 costs 1 segment (0.867); the other five families cost nothing.
